rule: Quest clock: remaining world seconds decremented by the world-time delta on each quest tick (10 per second); start value fixed, random between two values, random 1 min to 7 days when unspecified (donor TODO), or travel time times 2.5 with a 1-day floor. Interval spawn (create foe): interval N game minutes, random first phase in [0, interval), each slot uses one percent roll and is consumed either way, one event at a time, count or infinite. Intermittent encounters: per game minute catch-up, a 12-minute window per 144 game minutes, per-window roll by place and time of day, minimum spawn distance 8 to 10 tiles, one enemy per encounter, loop breaks at the first spawn. Encounter pick: place-indexed 20-entry ladder, d100 band around player level (81-95 wider, 96-100 widest, 1-80 level plus or minus 3), clamped at the ends. Faction drift: weekly power step by percent roll weighted by allies, enemies, parent and ruler bonus; 38-day conditions update; 84-day racial override check; 112-day reputation normalise; rumour line emitted per change.
keep: Quest clock as a visible countdown in world days
